desc: negative: opt=plain cmd=ng:br:batch:nodev-force: nodev returns -1 and -force goes on; the next line is unfiltered, since filter_index was set to 0
pre: ip link add br0 address 02:00:00:00:01:00 type bridge vlan_filtering 1 && ip link set br0 addrgenmode none

ip link add d1 address 02:00:00:00:01:01 type dummy && ip link set d1 addrgenmode none && ip link set d1 master br0 && ip link set d1 up && ip link add d2 address 02:00:00:00:01:02 type dummy && ip link set d2 addrgenmode none && ip link set d2 master br0 && ip link set d2 up && ip link set br0 up
bridge vlan add dev d1 vid 10 pvid untagged && bridge vlan add dev d1 vid 20-25 && bridge vlan add dev d2 vid 30 && bridge vlan add dev br0 vid 10 self
bridge link set dev d2 learning off cost 7 priority 5 hairpin on
printf '%s\n' 'vlan show dev nosuch' 'vlan show' > b.txt
